notes.title: The demo version of Rewinder 2 is now live
notes.content:
Dear Friends,
The demo version of Rewinder 2 is now live! We have received numerous feedback from our Septermber internal tests, thanks for everyone who wrote us feedback. Many of them have been addressed. We can't wait to show you our new demo in this Steam Next Fest.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3204560/2/

As we mentioned before, Rewinder 2 has undergone many changes. 
The game perspective has shifted from 2D side-scrolling to top-down view, 
adding more puzzle-solving gameplay and incorporating elements of exploration and combat. 
We hope to bring you a fresh experience while maintaining the core "Rewinding" mechanism.

Although we have made several improvement, the game is still under development. 
We welcome all feedback. Please help us make it better! You can reach us at Discord/X/QQ.
Chinese players can directly send us feedback via a QA from.

For players who wish to use a controller to play the game, please disable Steam Input otherwise there maybe issues with keybindings. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000767/0c6dcb443ee3561e449ff092e2becfb00b7e8d27.png[/img]

If you are interested, please wishlist the game, this is very important to us!
Thank you all for your support, and happy rewinding!

notes.title: The Rewinder 2 Coming to Steam Soon!
notes.content:
Dear Rewinders,
We are so excited to anounce [b]The Rewinder 2[/b] - the project we have been working on for the last two years. It is our studio's second game and first sequel.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2915490/2/

[h1]About the Game[/h1]

The Rewinder 2 is an action adventure game based on eastern methology. This is a direct sequel taking place 2 years after the events of the original game. No prior knowledge of the original Rewinder is needed, though there are plenty of connections.

There is a lot of new stuff we would like to bring to this sequel. You may notice the game has become top-down view. We would like to focus on bringing more exploration and spatial puzzle solving experience this time. While keeping the rewinding concept, the game will introduce several new systems. You will gain new skills and charms while exploring dungeons and meet all sorts of ghosts and monsters. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35983271/db29884cb11fa1df6bf307683eb45e799994c555.png[/img]

We will reveal more content in upcoming months. I can't wait to see how you feel about it. Your feedback is always key to our development.

[h1]About Misty Mountain Studio[/h1]

We, as an indepandent game studio, aim to bring unique experience to our players. Our studio was founded in Melbourne, Australia in 2018. Our first game, The Rewinder, has received over 6000 reviews and rated overwelmingly positive on Steam. The Rewinder 1 has also joined XGP recently.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35983271/61c9bc8d8e4fb6891f25ff0711c777a550ddef69.png[/img]

[h1]Wishlist Now[/h1]
Our journey can not be completed without you. Please [u][b]wishlist[/b][/u] now.

notes.title: DLC - Root of Evil is out now！English update next week
notes.content:
Dear Rewinders,

First of all, we want to thank you for your support. It's been almost 5 months since we launched The Rewinder, and we are so grateful to every one of you that bought, played and reviewed our game.

Since the launch, we've been hard at work making our DLC "Root of Evil", to be released today! 

Unfortunately, because of some adjustments we had to make, we need to delay the English launch for the DLC for a few days.

We sincerely apologize for the delay in English localization. The Rewinder is inspired by the stories and mythologies we grew up with, and we hope to share it with people across the globe. It's been a challenge but also a fun experience trying to come up with terms to explain Taoist mythologies in English. That's why we want to spend more time and care to make sure the English version is easy to understand and fully polished.

The localization team are hard at work, and we are planning to patch the English version next week. We will inform you via annoucement once ready. Meanwhile, you can buy "The Rewinder" (-30% off) and the OST (-50% off)  at a new historically low discount. So if you are interested, you can buy the fully localized base game now and wait for the DLC English update!

Once again, we are sorry for the delay, and thank you for supporting The Rewinder!

Our DLC, Root of Evil, is coming on March 11th. It's a brand new story about the adventures of Mont, Yun's father.

In this new DLC, we tried to bring new experiences. This includes: 
higher degree of freedom in the memory level; 
multiple endings that encourages exploration; 
unique puzzle-combat elements.

During the DLC launch, the base game and the OST will also go into discount - at our lowest price ever! So it's a great chance to grab it if you are new to the Rewinder, or want to gift it to a friend.

Lastly, we want to thank you for all the support and comments over the last six months! We hope you will enjoy the DLC!

notes.title: The Rewinder is NOW AVAILABLE! Get special Discounts in the launch week!
notes.content:
Dear players,
 
We are so excited to announce that The Rewinder is now available on Steam! 
 
This chilling point-and-click puzzle adventure game will introduce you to the magical world of Chinese mythology, where you can go on an exciting adventure, meet gods and monsters, and solve supernatural mysteries. You'll play as Yun, a young inhabitant of the Underworld. Tasked by the Black and White Spirit Wardens, he takes on the case of missing souls in a cursed village. We are also providing a special bundle that includes the Original Soundtrack of the game – with 23 original songs composed by our friends at MoonCake Audio. notes.title: Check Out The Rewinder's final trailer!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we have a final trailer for you!

[previewyoutube=Q8jg6FEBlh0;full][/previewyoutube]

The Rewinder will launch on Steam on September 10th, at 12am PDT. It features six main chapters, about a dozen characters (human and non-human), an original soundtrack of ~20 tracks, a regular ending and a secret ending for you to discover. We expect a regular playthrough to be 4-5 hours, although it might vary depending on how you get along with the puzzles.

In this final trailer, we share a little more about our story world and the gameplay elements, hope you enjoy it!

---------------------
With that out of the way, a small personal note:

With the release date fast approaching, it is a busy and emotional time for all of us in the dev team. We can't help but look back at when it all started, as a tiny part-time two-person studio more than 3 years ago. So we wanted to share with you a little bit about the inspirations and motivations for why we made this game:

The Rewinder is clearly inspired by our culture - the pixel art style is inspired by traditional Chinese ink paintings, and you'll see various elements in our story that are taken from the mythologies we grew up with. In the full version of the game, you'll see puzzles built around things like the abacus, the steelyard scale and the spinning wheel - things that were around for thousands or hundreds of years, but might be quickly going out of fashion, replaced by computers and machines. 

So in making them a part of this game, we hope to share a little piece of our culture and our memory with you - from all around the world. And where better to do that than in a puzzle game? Hopefully, even if you have never seen or used a steelyard scale in real life, you would enjoy the challenge of learning how they work as a part of our puzzle. As game developers, there's no greater joy than that.

September 10th, let's rewind the world.

notes.title: The Rewinder Release Date Moved Up to September 10th

So stay tuned to join Qi Yun on his adventures on September 10th, and we'll keep you updated!

notes.title: China s indie scene is flourishing, so here are 6 Chinese indie games to look out for in 2020
notes.content:
In December 2019, China s indie scene was out in full force at WePlay in Shanghai, arguably the most significant developer-focused event in the country. Paired with the China Indie Game Alliance (CiGA) conference, the annual convention is a highlight for the mainland s relatively young game scene.

Chinese heavyweights like Next Studios, TapTap, bilibili, and Coconut Island held court on the floor the latter had a booth styled as a nostalgic classroom with a blackboard and wooden desks. There were also, of course, international names like Blizzard, Ubisoft, and 505 Games. But the real stars of the show were from smaller studios, each offering an intriguing look at the range and depth of the Chinese indie landscape.
